caveat: Elevation blends the within-hour RANK of wild-type cell density with the within-hour normalised density, both inverted, so a basin is where cells accumulate. Monotone but not proportional, and not comparable between hours. It is an interpretive rendering of transcriptomic state space — not anatomy, not a tracked lineage, and nothing rolls down it.
